question: Do source-scope tinted cross-unit flux ribbons make long causal diagonals traceable without deleting the relation?

variant.variant: stable source-scope tint on cross-scope causal ribbons
variant.source: cockpit shot recaptured after the change

implementation: Host stamps data.ribbon.color from the palette for causal edges whose endpoint scopes differ; FluxEdge reads data only. No contract field, renderer branch or policy knob.
observation: Cross-unit orders filaments now carry distinct source-scope colors while within-unit causal ribbons keep the single causal color. The relation is preserved; camera framing and node positions are unstable between captures, so pixel identity is not a gate (TODO6 invariant 10).
